name: Crushed Ore
description: What crushing an ore gives; wash or smelt it for metal.

pages.title: Crushed Ore
pages.text:
**Crushed ore**, such as Crushed Raw Iron, is what Crushing Wheels or a Millstone make from ore.\
\
Smelt or blast it into an ingot, or wash it with a fan for nuggets and a chance of a byproduct. Crush ore **blocks**, not raw ore items: a block gives a crushed ore plus a 75%% chance of a second one.
